name: @anywalletkit/protocol-swap2-symbiosis
description: Symbiosis — any-to-any cross-chain swaps between seven EVM chains, Tron and TON through Symbiosis' public API: one call to the pinned MetaRouterGateway (or one jetton transfer to the pinned TON portal), decoded and bound to the request on the device; every reported fee in the quote, limits enforced locally.
